continuity_scope: FINAL FANTASY TACTICS 獵子戦争 (Final Fantasy Tactics: The War of the Lions), Japanese PlayStation Portable launch edition of 10 May 2007. This is a separate pass from the multi-title Final Fantasy sample (SRC-129), the 1997 original release, later mobile ports, Final Fantasy Tactics: The Ivalice Chronicles, and other Ivalice titles.
work_or_witnesses: Square Enix product detail: FINAL FANTASY TACTICS 獵子戦争, PlayStation Portable, 2007.05.10
Square Enix Game Books catalogue: ファイナルファンタジータクティクス 獵子戦争 公式コンプリートガイド
coverage_rule: All individually named characters explicitly identified in the selected edition's official product-page story synopsis. The synopsis names only Ramza and Delita; each has a record. Source-native setting and release features remain source terms rather than character nodes.
omissions: All other named people, because the selected official product synopsis does not identify them and no official character/codex profile for this bounded witness was used in this pass.
Jobs, factions, monsters, locations, the zodiac system, artifacts, and game mechanics; these are not character nodes.
The 1997 original, regional localizations, iOS/Android ports, Final Fantasy Tactics: The Ivalice Chronicles, and other Ivalice works.
uncertainties: The selected official page is a high-level Japanese synopsis, not a complete dramatis-personae or chapter/codex archive; this pass is complete only for its explicit-name rule.
The official Japanese witness gives the names ラムザ and ディリータ. English localized surnames and other name variants were not asserted without a directly inspected edition-specific official profile.

The web product page is dynamically rendered; its product and story wording was checked from Square Enix's official page metadata/search rendering. Claims beyond that wording are intentionally excluded.
evidence_basis: First-party Square Enix edition page for the release boundary, story synopsis, named figures, and their stated connection; first-party Square Enix guide catalogue for the guide's date, extent, and added-content terminology. No fan wiki or unofficial plot summary was used as evidence.

supports: Selected Japanese PSP edition and release date
Ramza and Delita as the two explicitly named story figures
New movies and jobs in this edition
Official guide witness and its coverage of added joint-battle and new-job elements
